categories.name: Toys
categories.description:
1. Soft toys & plush
Naram, cuddly aur safe soft toys jo bachon ke best friend ban jaate hain. Teddy bears, cute animals aur favourite characters ka collection, gift dene ke liye perfect.

2. Action figures & dolls
Bachon ki kahaniyon ko zinda karne wale dolls, doll houses aur superhero figures. Imagination aur role play ke liye best choice.

3. Educational & learning toys
Khel khel mein seekhne wale puzzles, alphabet aur number toys, STEM kits aur flash cards. Bachon ka dimaag tez karein aur creativity badhayein.

4. Building blocks & construction
Blocks se ghar, gaadi ya kuch bhi banao. Ye sets focus, problem solving aur hand-eye coordination improve karte hain.

5. Remote control & vehicles
Fast RC cars, pull-back cars, trains aur helicopters. Speed aur masti pasand karne wale bachon ke liye.

6. Board games & indoor games
Ludo, carrom, card games aur family games. Poore parivaar ke saath quality time bitane ke liye.

7. Outdoor & sports toys
Cricket sets, footballs, skipping ropes aur water guns. Bachon ko active aur healthy rakhne wale outdoor toys.

8. Baby & toddler toys
Chhote bachon ke liye safe aur colourful rattles, teethers aur musical toys. Soft material aur baby-friendly design ke saath.

9. Pretend play & role play
Kitchen sets, doctor sets, tool sets aur makeup sets. Bachon ko bade hone ka mazaa dete hain aur social skills banate hain.

10. Art, craft & stationery
Colouring kits, clay, slime aur DIY craft. Bachon ki creativity ko ek nayi udaan dein.

This toy comes with 3 lovely ducklings, 1 stairs part as well as 3 sliding tracks. After assembly and start the toy, the ducklings will be sent to the top one by one and then slide back to the starting point for the next round.
Safe Material: ABS material, environment protection, safe and durable. All parts are round and smooth without any sharp edges, which is safe for children. 6+ Age Kids Can play this Toy.
Climb The Stairs Automatically: There is a mechanism inside the main part of the toy that enables the stairs part works like an escalator. The lovely ducklings will be sent to the top just like they are taking the escalator.
Unique Design: The toy set comes with flashing LED light, which is easy to assemble. The toy contains cheerful music (with on/off button). Happy little ducks climb the stairs and slide down the slope happily.
Music & Light Function: Dynamic music will sound and shinning lights can be seen as the toy starts working, which makes the toy more funny and attracts kids' attention more easily.

This wooden intelligence puzzle features a colorful collection of interlocking block pieces arranged inside a wooden tray. Designed as a shape matching and brain teaser activity, the puzzle encourages children and adults to explore different arrangements while developing logical thinking and spatial awareness.

Interactive Learning Activity
The puzzle includes multiple geometric block shapes in bright colors that fit together inside the wooden board. Players can experiment with different combinations and configurations, creating an engaging challenge suitable for individual or shared play sessions.
